blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Web agents built on vision language models decide every action by generating text such as click(12), although most of that text encodes a choice among a few action types and a few dozen marked elements. We read these choices directly from the hidden states that the generator computes while it reads the goal and the screenshot. Plug-in decision heads on a frozen generator predict the action type, pool the visual tokens inside each numbered box to pick the target, and point at a listed text option or at a WRITE slot that leaves the writing of new text to the generator. A confidence cascade executes the heads' action when they are sure and otherwise lets the generator decode from the KV cache of the same forward pass. With Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B generators trained on 213k web steps, a strict threshold keeps the cascade between 0.3 points below and 1.4 points above the generator on seven offline test sets while the heads decide 12 to 64% of the steps. A looser threshold raises step success on unseen Mind2Web websites by 3.1 and 1.8 points, costs up to 2 points on GUIAct and MiniWoB++, and lifts WebArena task success from 12.5 to 13.8% (4B) and from 13.6 to 14.6% (8B) with less than half of the generated tokens. Training the heads jointly with the generator lowers the generator's own step success by up to 4.9 points; heads on a frozen generator avoid this cost.
blocks.zh: 建立在视觉语言模型之上的Web代理通过生成点击(12)等文本来决定每个动作,尽管该文本的大部分编码是在少数动作类型和几十个标记元素中选择的. 我们直接从隐藏的状态读取这些选择, 即生成器在读取目标与截图时计算。 在冷冻的生成器上插入决策头来预测动作类型,将每个编号框内的视觉符号集合起来来选择目标,并指向列出的文本选项或WRITE槽,将新文本的写法留给生成器. 信任级联在头部确定时执行动作,否则让生成器从同一前传的 KV 缓存中解码. 由于Qune3-VL 4B和8B发电机在213k网络台阶上接受训练,一个严格的阈值使得级联在7个离线测试集上保持在0.3点到1.4点之间,而头部则决定12-64%的台阶. 更松散的门槛让未见的Mind2Web网站的步数成功3.1和1.8分,在GUIAct和MiniWoB++上成本高达2分,并将WebArena任务成功率从12.5%提高到13.8%(4B),从13.6%提高到14.6%(8B),生成的令牌不到一半. 与发电机联合训练头部,使发电机本身的步法成功率降低多达4.9分;冷冻发电机上的头部避免了这一成本.

blocks.en: A web agent built on a vision language model acts by writing. At each step the model reads the goal and a screenshot whose elements carry numbered boxes, then generates a string such as click(6) or type(5, "chair") that a harness parses and executes ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024a ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) . Most of this string records a choice from a short list: one of eleven action types and one of a few dozen boxes. Only the text of a typing or answering step is open ended. Writing a choice out token by token costs one sequential decoding pass per token, and it scores only the one string written, with no explicit distribution over whole alternative actions.
blocks.zh: 一个网络代理基于视觉语言模型的行为通过写作. 在每一步骤,模型都读取一个目标并取出一个截图,其内容携带了编号的框,然后生成一个绳子,如点击(6)或类型(5,"椅子"),一个绳子会画出并被执行(郑等,2024;Koh等,2024a; 许等,2024; 秦等,2025. ). 此字符串大多记录从一个短列表中选择:11个动作类型之一和几十个框中的一个. 只有打字或答题步骤的文字是打开的。 用符号写出一个选择出个符号,花费每个符号一个相继解码传出,它只得一个字符串的分数,对整个可选动作没有明确的分布.

blocks.en: By the time the generator writes its first token, it has read the goal, the history and every box on the screen, and that first token already commits to an action type. Like other properties that probes recover from intermediate layers ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ) , and like the knowledge that probing and editing studies locate inside large language and multimodal models ( Jiang et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2025a ; Qi et al., 2025 ) , the decision should therefore be readable from the hidden states of the prefill (Figure 1 ). This suggests a cheaper way to act: read the decision from those states with small heads, and generate only what the heads cannot express. Two questions determine whether this is worth doing. On which steps do heads read the decision as reliably as the generator writes it? And can an agent use the heads on those steps and generation on the rest without paying for both?

blocks.en: Our answer is a set of plug-in decision heads (Figure 2 ). A type head pools the whole prefill, a target head pools the visual tokens inside each numbered box and scores the box against a learned query, and an argument head points at the text options listed in the prompt or at a WRITE slot that returns the writing of new text to the generator. The heads read a learned mix of five layers of a frozen generator and add about 0.1% to its parameters. A confidence cascade executes the heads’ action when the product of their probabilities reaches a threshold τ \tau . Otherwise the generator decodes from the KV cache of the forward pass the heads already read.
blocks.zh: 我们的答案是一组插头决定(图2). 一个类型头集合整个预填,一个目标头集合每个编号框内的可视符号,并对照一个学到的查询对盒子进行打分,以及一个参数头点在提示所列出的文本选项上,或者在WRITE槽上,将新文本的写入返回到生成器上. 头部读取了五层被冷冻的生成器的学习组合,并增加了大约0.1%的参数. 信心级联在头部的概率值达到临界值时执行头部的行动。 否则,生成器会从前方的 KV 缓存中解码, 通过已经读取的头。

blocks.en: We train Qwen3-VL generators of 4B and 8B parameters on 213k web steps from MiniWoB++, Mind2Web, GUIAct, UGround and WebLINX, and then train heads on each frozen generator. At τ = 0.9 \tau=0.9 the cascade matches its generator on all seven offline test sets, from 0.3 points below to 1.4 above, while the heads decide 12 to 64% of the steps. At τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 step success on Mind2Web websites unseen in training rises by 3.1 (4B) and 1.8 (8B) points, and the four GUIAct test sets lose 1.0 to 1.9 points. On WebArena the cascade completes 13.8% and 14.6% of 174 test tasks, against 12.5% and 13.6% for the generators, and generates 3.1 and 3.3 tokens per step instead of 7.4 and 7.5; the gain comes from tasks whose intent template also occurs in training. Training the heads together with the generator in one adapter lowers the generator’s own step success by 0.5 to 4.9 points, and on Mind2Web and WebArena this cost outweighs the stronger heads that joint training yields.
blocks.zh: 我们从MiniWoB++,Mind2Web,GUIAct,UGround和WebLINX在213k网络台阶上训练由4B和8B参数组成的Quen3-VL发电机,然后在每个被冻结的发电机上训练头. 在 = 0.9\tau=0.9 时,级联在所有7个离线测试装置上与发电机相匹配,从下方的0.3分到上方的1.4分,而头部则决定各步骤的12%至64%. 在"\=0.5\tau=0.5"的Mind2Web网站上,在训练中看不见的台阶成功率上升了3.1分(4B分)和1.8分(8B分),而"GUIAct"的4个测试集损失了1.0分到1.9分. 在WebArena, 级联完成174项测试任务的13.8%和14.6%,发电机为12.5%和13.6%,每步生成3.1和3.3个令牌,而不是7.4和7.5;收益来自其意图模板也出现在培训中的任务。 在Mind2Web和WebArena上, 这笔费用超过联合训练产生的更强人头。

blocks.en: Decision heads give an existing web agent a second and cheaper way to act without retraining it. The generator stays untouched, so every step the heads hand back is decided exactly as before, and every step they decide comes with an explicit distribution over types, boxes and options that a harness can threshold, log or search over ( Koh et al., 2024b ) . Decoding is then reserved for uncertain steps and for text that the option list does not contain.
blocks.zh: 决策负责人给现有的网络代理商提供了另一种廉价的方式,无需再培训。 生成器没有动过,所以头接回的每个步骤都和以前一样决定,他们决定的每一个步骤都有明确的种类、盒子和选项分布,这些种类、盒和选项可以让绳子进入、登录或搜索(Koh等人,2024年b ) 。 然后对选项列表中没有的不确定步骤和文本进行解码.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: MiniWoB++ ( Shi et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2018 ) , Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and VisualWebArena ( Koh et al., 2024a ) evaluate agents that map a page and a goal to an action. Current vision language agents write this action as text, either as element ids on Set-of-Mark screenshots ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) or as screen coordinates after large-scale grounding training ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , with parsers such as OmniParser ( Lu et al., 2024 ) supplying the elements. Earlier agents used dedicated output layers: CC-Net ( Humphreys et al., 2022 ) predicts factored actions with policy heads, MindAct ( Deng et al., 2023 ) ranks candidate elements before a language model chooses among them, and GUI-Actor ( Wu et al., 2026 ) replaces coordinate generation with an attention head over image patches, which can also be trained on a frozen backbone.

(周等,2024年)和VisualWebarena(Koh等,2024年a)评价将一页和一目标映射到一行动的代理商. 当前的视觉语言代理人将此动作写成文字,或者作为Set-Of-Mark截图上的元素标识(Yang等,2023;Zheng等,2024),或者作为大规模地取地训练后的屏幕坐标(Cheng等,2024;Hong等). ; Gou等,2025; Wu等,2025; Xu等,2024; 秦等,2025; 有OmniParser(Lu等,2024)等解析器提供元素. 早期的代理商使用专用输出层:CC-Net(Humphreys等,2022年)预测与政策主管一起的有因素的行动, MindAct(Deng等,2023年)在语言模型中选择前对候选元素进行排名,而GUI-Actor(Wu等,2026年)则将坐标生成以注意力头取而代之于图像补丁来取而代之,还可以用被冷冻的骨干来训练.

blocks.en: Early exit methods stop at an intermediate layer once a classifier is confident ( Teerapittayanon et al., 2016 ; Xin et al., 2020 ; Schuster et al., 2022 ) , selective classifiers abstain below a confidence threshold ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ) , cascades send easy queries to cheaper models ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , speculative decoding and Medusa draft tokens that the full model verifies ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) , and visual token compression shortens the multimodal prefill itself ( Peng et al., 2025 ) . SwiftSage pairs a fast small agent with a slow large one ( Lin et al., 2023 ) . These methods save computation within text generation or across models, and the agent’s decision is still written out as text. Appendix H discusses further related work.

blocks.en: Earlier action heads either replace the language model, as in CC-Net, or replace generation for one part of the action, as in MindAct and GUI-Actor. Our heads read the whole action, its type, target box and text option, from the prefill of a frozen generator agent and return control to that generator through a WRITE slot or a confidence threshold, so heads and generation become two readouts of one forward pass. We also measure what joint training costs the agent’s own generation. Decision heads thus become an add-on for existing generator agents.
blocks.zh: 早期动作头要么像CC-Net那样替换语言模型,要么像MindAct和GUI-Actor那样替换部分动作的生成. 我们的头读整个动作,它的类型,目标框和文本选项,从一个被冷冻的生成器的预填到通过WRITE插槽或置信阈值返回控制到该生成器,所以头和一代就成了两个读出一个前传. 我们还衡量联合培训的费用。 因此,决策主管成为现有发电机代理的附加。

blocks.en: 4.1 Data and Backbones

blocks.en: The generators are Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) with a rank 16 LoRA adapter on every attention and MLP projection of the language model. They train for one epoch on 213k steps that we convert into the format of Section 3.1 : successful MiniWoB++ episodes on training seeds (9.2k steps, repeated three times), the Multimodal-Mind2Web training split ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) (7.3k), GUIAct web single and multi step tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) with scroll and answer steps (94k), web grounding data from UGround ( Gou et al., 2025 ) (65k) and WebLINX demonstrations ( Lù et al., 2024 ) (38k). The heads train for one epoch on the same steps with the generator frozen. Appendix A describes the conversion and Appendix B the optimization.
blocks.zh: 发电机为Qune3-VL-4B-Instruct和Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct(Bai等,2025年),在语言模型的每个注意力和MLP投影上,都拥有16等LORA适配器. 他们在213k步上训练一个时代,我们将其转换成第3.1节的格式:成功的MiniWoB++关于训练种子的节目(9.2k步,重复了三次);Multimodule-Mind2Web训练分裂(Deng等人,2023;Zheng等人,2024)(7.3k);GUIAct网络单步和多步任务(Chen等人,2025年);滚动和回答步骤(94k);UGround的网络地面数据(Gou等人,2025)(65k);WebLINX演示(Lú等人,2024)(38k)。 车头在同一个时间段 与发电机冻结。 附 录 A描述了转换和附录B的优化。

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarks and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 基准和计量

blocks.en: We use the three Multimodal-Mind2Web (M2W) test splits, cross-task, cross-website and cross-domain, whose tasks, websites or domains are unseen in training, and the GUIAct web test sets for single and multi step tasks together with their extended versions (ext.) that add scroll and answer steps. For each M2W step we cut a 1280 × 1000 1280\times 1000 window at a random height that keeps the gold element visible and draw up to 64 candidates: the gold element, the other positive candidates and random negatives. GUIAct steps likewise show the target and up to 63 other elements. This gives 1,253, 973 and 3,820 M2W steps and 1,089, 421, 1,410 and 854 GUIAct steps; Section 5.4 also counts, as failures, the 372 M2W steps whose gold element cannot be shown. A step succeeds when the chosen box is a gold box and the operation, including any text, matches.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个Multimodule-Mind2W(M2W)测试分解,跨任务,跨网站和跨域,它们的任务,网站或域在训练中是看不见的;使用GUIAct网络测试集,用于单步和多步任务及其扩展版本(ext.)来添加卷轴并解答步骤. 对于M2W的每个步骤,我们剪取一个1280×1000 1280\times1000的窗口,在随机高地上保持金元素的能见度并绘制出最多64个候选:金元素,其他正候选人和随机负. 同样,GUIAct步骤显示了目标,其他要素多达63个。 这给了1,253,973和3,820个M2W步骤以及1,089,421,1,410和854个GUIAct步骤;第5.4节也算作失败,其金元素无法显示的372个M2W步骤. 当所选的框是金盒子和操作,包括任何文本,匹配时,一步成功.

blocks.en: MiniWoB++ runs all 119 tasks with five seeds each through BrowserGym ( Chezelles et al., 2024 ) , at most 10 steps per episode; 12 tasks are held out from training. WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) runs 174 test tasks on six sites with at most 25 steps per task. Success follows the WebArena checkers, with GPT-5.5 judging answers that need fuzzy matching, and every run starts from freshly reset sites.
blocks.zh: MiniWoB++通过浏览器Gym(Chezelles等,2024年)运行了所有119个任务,每个任务有5个种子,每集最多10个步骤;12个任务从训练中被解除. WebArena (Zhou等,2024年)在6个站点执行174个测试任务,每个任务最多25步. 成功跟随WebArena检查器,GPT-5.5判断需要模糊匹配的答案,每跑从新重置站点开始.

blocks.en: We replace our target head with the patch attention head of GUI-Actor ( Wu et al., 2026 ) : the target query attends over every visual token covered by a candidate, training raises the attention mass on the tokens of the gold box, and at test time the top token selects the smallest candidate that contains it. We train both variants as joint heads on the MiniWoB++ and M2W portion of the data. Heads only with box pooling is ahead on four of five test sets (Table 8 ), for instance 37.3 against 35.3 on M2W cross-task. Box pooling gives every candidate its own score. Scoring each box by the attention mass inside it instead fails on M2W, where 82% of the test steps contain a larger candidate that encloses the gold box and always collects at least as much mass; the smallest-candidate rule of GUI-Actor is needed to avoid this.
blocks.zh: 我们用GUI-Actor的补丁注意力头取而代之(Wu等,2026年) :目标查询在候选人覆盖的每个视觉标志上进行,训练会提高金盒标志上的注意量,在测试时最高标志会选择包含它的最小候选. 我们把两个变体作为联合头来训练 在MiniWoB++和M2W部分的数据。 5个测试组中的4个测试组(表8)领先,例如M2W交叉任务37.3对35.3。 盒集给每个候选人自己的分数。 在M2W上通过内置的注意力质量对每个盒子进行分解,在M2W上82%的测试步骤中包含一个更大的候选对象,该候选对象将金盒包裹起来,并且总能收集至少同样多的质量;需要GUI-Actor最小的扫描规则来避免这种情况.

blocks.en: 6.4 Heads on a Reasoning Generator

blocks.en: A generator can also write a short thought before its action, in the style of ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . We train such a 4B generator on MiniWoB++ only. Its thoughts come from sampling four thought and action pairs per step from the untuned 8B model and keeping a thought whose action matches the demonstration, in the spirit of STaR ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) ; this covers 57% of the 7,675 deduplicated steps, and the others receive a thought written with the demonstrated action in view. Table 9 shows that thoughts do not help here: the reasoning generator trails the generator without thoughts by 4.0 points and is seven times slower.
blocks.zh: 生成器也可以在其动作前以"ReAct"(姚等,2022. 我们只在MiniWoB++上 训练这么一台4B型发电机 其想法来自从未调整的8B模型中逐步抽取出4个想法和行动对,并本着STaR(Zelikman等,2022年)的精神,保留一个其行动与演示相符的想法;这涵盖了7,675个被贬损的步骤中的57%,其他步骤则得到了与演示行动相关的思考。 表9显示,思考在这里没有帮助:推理生成器在没有思考的情况下跟踪生成器4.0分并慢了7倍.

blocks.en: The heads save the most on such a generator, because every step they take alone skips a whole thought. Trained in the same adapter, the joint heads act alone on two thirds of the steps, raise success from 51.0 to 51.5% over the adapter’s own generation, and cut the time per step from 1.56 to 0.70 seconds. With thoughts, the joint adapter also generates better than the separately trained reasoning generator (51.0 against 49.9).
blocks.zh: 头部在这样的发电机上保存得最多,因为每个步骤都单独跳过一个整体的想法. 在同一个适配器的训练下,联合头像在三分之二的台阶上单独行动,将适配器自身一代的成功率从51.0%提高到51.5%,并将每台阶的时间从1.56秒缩短到0.70秒. 通过思考,联合适配器也能产生优于单独训练的推理生成器(51.0对49.9).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: A web agent can read many of its decisions from the prefill it already computes. Heads on a frozen generator decide the steps they read well and pass the rest, together with any new text, to the same generator. At a strict threshold the agent keeps the generator’s accuracy, and at a looser one it gains on unseen websites and on WebArena while generating less than half of the tokens.
blocks.zh: 一个网络代理可以从它已经计算的预填中读取它的许多决定. 一个被冻结的发电机上的人头决定他们读得好的台阶,然后将其余部分连同任何新的文字一起传递给同一个发电机. 在严格的门槛下,代理保持了发电机的准确性,在松散的门槛下,它可以在隐蔽网站和WebArena上获得,同时生成不到一半的令牌。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our heads choose among numbered boxes, so agents that act through raw screen coordinates would need a different target head. The heads are tied to one generator; after fine-tuning the generator for WebArena we trained them again. All experiments use Qwen3-VL backbones and a single action grammar, and the threshold is fixed per experiment.
blocks.zh: 我们的头在编号的盒子中选择 所以通过原始屏幕坐标行事的特工 需要一个不同的目标头 头被绑在一台发电机上; 在微调了WebArena的发电机后,我们再次训练了它们。 所有实验都使用Qune3-VL骨干和一个单动作语法,每个实验的阈值是固定的.

blocks.en: Table 10: Converted training steps per source, before deduplication. MiniWoB++ excludes the held-out tasks; the WebArena replay is used only for the WebArena fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 表10: 每一来源的转换培训步骤,在减员之前。 MiniWoB++ 排除被搁置的任务; WebArena 重放仅用于WebArena的微调.

blocks.en: Every source is converted into the same step record: a screenshot, the candidate boxes in reading order, the element list with roles and names, the goal, the history and the demonstrated action in our grammar (Table 10 ). Boxes are drawn at load time with a colored frame and the number inside the top left corner, so that the label never covers a neighboring element. Web pages are rendered 960 pixels wide. blocks.en: We use 174 test tasks of WebArena (gitlab 44, shopping admin 39, shopping 34, reddit 29, map 24, wikipedia 4) and a disjoint set of training tasks, split at the task level. Expert trajectories come from a GPT-5.5 Set-of-Mark agent on the training tasks; we keep its 234 successful trajectories on 139 tasks. Because our boxes differ from the expert’s, we replay each trajectory in the live sites, record at every step what our agent would see (the viewport scaled from 1440 × 900 1440\times 900 to 960 × 600 960\times 600 , our candidate boxes and the history), and write the expert action in our grammar. A step whose target is not among our boxes is executed but not kept, and a trajectory is dropped when the page diverges or the replay is not scored successful again. This yields 191 trajectories on 115 tasks with 1,298 steps; after removing 369 duplicates and 13 unparsable steps, 871 steps train and 45 validate.

blocks.en: Appendix H Further Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录H 相关工作

blocks.en: Our heads read a decision that a large multimodal model has already formed in its hidden states. A neighboring line of work studies the knowledge these models hold and how it can be measured and changed. MINED probes and updates time-sensitive multimodal knowledge ( Jiang et al., 2026b ) , Jiang et al. (2026a) examine how such models cope with evolving knowledge, and KORE injects new knowledge through knowledge-oriented augmentations and constraints ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) . MMKE-Bench evaluates the editing of diverse visual knowledge ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) , in-context editing learns knowledge from self-induced distributions ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , and Jia et al. (2026) benchmark conflicts between multimodal knowledge sources. KnowHal measures knowledge-driven hallucination ( Li et al., 2026 ) , and Fu et al. (2026) test whether multimodal language models understand OCT images. These studies treat what the model knows as the object to probe or edit; our heads treat what the model has decided as the quantity to read out.
blocks.zh: 我们的首脑们读到了一个决定,即一个大型多式联运模式已经在其隐藏状态下形成。 相邻的一行工作研究这些模型掌握的知识,以及如何加以衡量和改变。 MINED探测并更新具有时间敏感性的多模式知识(Jiang等人,2026年b),Jiang等人(2026年a)研究这些模型如何应对不断变化的知识,KORE通过面向知识的增强和制约注入了新的知识(Jiang等人,2025年b) 。 。 。 。 MMKE-Bench评价了多种视觉知识的编辑(Jiang等,2025a),内文编辑从自发发行中学习知识. (Qi等,2025年),和贾等. (2026) 多式联运知识来源之间的基准冲突。 知道吗? Hal测量由知识驱动的幻觉(Li等,2026年),而Fu等. (2026)测试多模式语言模型是否理解OCT图像. 这些研究将模型所知道的东西当作探测或编辑的对象;我们的头把模型所决定的东西当作读出的数量.

blocks.en: Choosing a box among candidates is a ranking problem, and the same holds for choosing documents in retrieval augmented generation and deep research, where rubric-oriented selection ( Jiang et al., 2026d ) and adaptive tutoring ( Jiang et al., 2026c ) rank whole document sets. Our WebArena training data distill the trajectories of a proprietary agent into an open model, close in spirit to multi-agent protocol distillation for agentic search ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Visual token compression ( Peng et al., 2025 ) lowers the cost of the multimodal prefill that the cascade reuses, so its saving adds to the decoding that the heads skip.
blocks.zh: 在候选人中选择一个盒子是一个排位问题,在检索中选择文件也一样会增加生成和深入研究,其中面向主题的选择(Jiang等人,2026d)和适应性辅导(Jiang等人,2026c)将整套文件排位。 我们的WebArena训练数据将专有物剂的轨迹分解成开放模型,精神上接近于多剂协议分解以进行代理搜索(Liu等,2026年). 视觉令牌压缩(Peng等,2025年)降低了级联再利用的多式预填的成本,因此其节省增加了头部跳过的解码.
